MicrobiotaProcess import
```{r}
mpse_samples <- mp_import_qiime2(otuqza="data/microbiome/rarefied-table.qza", 
                          taxaqza="data/microbiome/taxonomy.qza", 
                          mapfilename="data/microbiome/metadata_edit.tsv")
mpse_samples

#Set labtracking column as the sample names
new_names <- colData(mpse_samples)$labtracking

# Make sure they are unique
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(new_names))

# Assign as sample names
colnames(mpse_samples) <- new_names
rownames(colData(mpse_samples)) <- new_names

#filter to only pema and drop AZ
mpse_samples_filtered <- mpse_samples %>%
  filter(specificEpithet == "maniculatus") %>%
  filter(stateProvince != "Arizona")

mpse_asv_table <- assay(mpse_samples_filtered, "Abundance")

mpse_bc_dist   <- vegdist(t(mpse_asv_table), method = "bray") 
mpse_sor_dist  <- vegdist(t(mpse_asv_table), method = "bray", binary = TRUE) 

labs <- attr(mpse_bc_dist, "Labels")
```

phyloseq import
```{r}
physeq <- qza_to_phyloseq(
  features  = "data/microbiome/rarefied-table.qza",
  tree      = "data/microbiome/rooted-tree.qza",
  taxonomy  = "data/microbiome/taxonomy.qza",
  metadata  = "MicrobiotaProcess_sample_data.tsv"
)

#---------------------------
# Sample filtering
#---------------------------
ps <- physeq %>%
  ps_filter(scientificName == "Peromyscus maniculatus") %>%
  ps_filter(stateProvince != "Arizona")

sample_names(ps) <- sample_data(ps)$labtracking

meta <- data.frame(sample_data(ps))

meta$decimalLatitude  <- as.numeric(meta$decimalLatitude)
meta$decimalLongitude <- as.numeric(meta$decimalLongitude)

# optional export
write.table(
  meta,
  file = "meta.tsv",
  sep = "\t",
  row.names = FALSE,
  quote = FALSE
)
```

geographic distance
```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Geographic distance
# -----------------------------
#distance from a centroid
coords <- as.matrix(meta[, c("decimalLongitude", "decimalLatitude")])
centroid <- colMeans(coords, na.rm = TRUE)
meta$geo_km <- distVincentyEllipsoid(coords, centroid) / 1000

#or 

#distance in a matrix
coords2 <- meta[, c("decimalLongitude", "decimalLatitude")]
geo_dist <- distm(coords2, fun = distHaversine) / 1000 
rownames(geo_dist) <- rownames(meta) 
colnames(geo_dist) <- rownames(meta)
```

ANCOMBC
```{r}
# Remove uncultured / unclassified / unidentified taxa
ps2 <- subset_taxa(
  ps,
  !grepl(
    "uncultured|unclassified|unidentified|unknown|uncultured",
    Genus,
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )
)

out = ancombc(data = ps2, formula = "Region", p_adj_method = "fdr")

results_ancom_bc = data.frame(ASV = out$res$lfc$taxon,
                              lcf = out$res$lfc$Regionwest, 
                              W = out$res$W$Regionwest, 
                              p_val = out$res$p_val$Regionwest, 
                              q_value = out$res$q_val$Regionwest, 
                              Diff_ab =  out$res$diff_abn$Regionwest)
results_ancom_bc$lcf = results_ancom_bc$lcf * -1

results_ancom_bc$association = ifelse(
  results_ancom_bc$q_value < 0.05 & results_ancom_bc$lcf > 0,
  "east",
  "Not Significant"
)

results_ancom_bc$association = ifelse(results_ancom_bc$q_value < 0.05 & results_ancom_bc$lcf < 0, "west",results_ancom_bc$association)

TAXtab =as.data.frame(tax_table(ps2))

name_tmp = sprintf("ASV%s",seq(1:nrow(TAXtab))) 
#now let's add some information to this. For example, we want to add the genus, and if not available, the last taxonomic information available.
TAXtab$name =  TAXtab$Species
TAXtab$name = ifelse(is.na(TAXtab$name), TAXtab$Genus, TAXtab$name)
TAXtab$name = ifelse(is.na(TAXtab$name), TAXtab$Family, TAXtab$name)
TAXtab$name = ifelse(is.na(TAXtab$name), TAXtab$Order, TAXtab$name)
TAXtab$name = ifelse(is.na(TAXtab$name), TAXtab$Class, TAXtab$name)
TAXtab$name = ifelse(is.na(TAXtab$name), TAXtab$Phylum, TAXtab$name)
unique(is.na(TAXtab$name)) # Ok, we have all names

TAXtab$ASVname = paste(name_tmp, TAXtab$name, sep = "-")
TAXtab$name[1:10] # ok it looks good.

results_ancom_bc$ASVname = TAXtab$ASVname[match(results_ancom_bc$ASV ,rownames(TAXtab))]

results_ancom_bc$Genus = TAXtab$Genus[match(results_ancom_bc$ASV ,rownames(TAXtab))]
results_sig = results_ancom_bc[results_ancom_bc$q_value < 0.05,]
table(results_sig$Diff_ab)
table(results_sig$ASVname,results_sig$Diff_ab, results_sig$Genus)

Sum_abundance= colSums(decostand(t(ps_otu), method = "total"))
results_sig$sum_abundance = Sum_abundance[match(results_sig$ASV, names(Sum_abundance))]
results_sig = results_sig[order(results_sig$sum_abundance, decreasing = TRUE),]
results_sig = results_sig[1:14,]
results_sig$ASVname = factor(results_sig$ASVname, levels = rev(results_sig$ASVname))


# Extract OTU table
otu_mat <- as.data.frame(otu_table(ps2))

# Make sure taxa are rows
if (!taxa_are_rows(ps2)) {
  otu_mat <- t(otu_mat)
}

otu_mat <- as.data.frame(otu_mat)

# Sample metadata
meta <- as.data.frame(sample_data(ps2))

# Add stateProvince
meta$SampleID <- rownames(meta)

# Convert OTU matrix to long format
otu_long <- otu_mat %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("ASV") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -ASV,
    names_to = "SampleID",
    values_to = "Abundance"
  ) %>%
  left_join(meta[, c("SampleID", "stateProvince")],
            by = "SampleID")

# Get dominant state for each ASV
asv_state <- otu_long %>%
  group_by(ASV, stateProvince) %>%
  summarise(total_abundance = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(ASV) %>%
  slice_max(total_abundance, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

# Merge into ANCOMBC results
results_ancom_bc <- left_join(
  results_ancom_bc,
  asv_state[, c("ASV", "stateProvince")],
  by = "ASV"
)

ggplot(results_ancom_bc,
       aes(x = as.numeric(lcf),
           y = -log10(as.numeric(q_value)),
           color = stateProvince)) +
  
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +
  
  geom_text_repel(
    data = subset(results_ancom_bc, q_value < 0.05),
    aes(label = ASVname),
    size = 4,
    max.overlaps = 20
  ) +
  
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0,
             linetype = "dashed",
             color = "gray50",
             linewidth = 0.8) +
  
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05),
             linetype = "dashed",
             color = "gray50",
             linewidth = 0.8) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Log2 Fold Change",
    y = expression(-log[10](q-value)),
    title = "Differentially Abundant Taxa",
    color = "State"
  ) +
  
  theme_bw(base_size = 18) +
  
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

ASVtab_rel = decostand(t(ps_otu), method = "total")
AASVtab_sig = data.frame(ASVtab_rel[,as.numeric(rownames(results_sig))])
colnames(AASVtab_sig) = results_sig$ASVname
AASVtab_sig$Region = meta$Region
melted = reshape2::melt(AASVtab_sig, values = "Region")
melted$variable = factor(melted$variable, levels = rev(results_sig$ASVname))
```

ASV by genus trees
```{r}
# 1. Agglomerate taxa to Genus level
ps_genus <- tax_glom(ps2, taxrank = "Genus")

# 2. Get names of top 10 genera by total abundance
top10_names <- names(sort(taxa_sums(ps_genus), decreasing = TRUE))[1:10]
#bottom10_names <- names(sort(taxa_sums(ps_genus), decreasing = FALSE)[1:10])

# 3. Prune the object to keep only these 10 (optional)
#ps_bottom10 <- prune_taxa(bottom10_names, ps_genus)

# 4. View the Taxa Table for these bottom 10
#tax_table(ps_bottom10)

# 3. Prune the agglomerated object to only these 10
ps_top10 <- prune_taxa(top10_names, ps_genus)
tax_table(ps_top10)

# Assign taxa names
taxa_names(ps2) <- TAXtab$ASVname


# Select genus of interest
g <- "Lactobacillus"

# Subset phyloseq object for that genus
ps_g <- subset_taxa(ps2, Genus == g)

# Create tree plot
tree_plot <- ggtree(phy_tree(ps_g))

asvtree<- phy_tree(ps_g)
plotTree(phy_tree(ps_g),fsize=0.8,ftype="i",
    lwd=1)

# Extract OTU and Region information
tree_df <- psmelt(ps_g) %>%
  dplyr::select(OTU, stateProvince,Abundance) %>%
  filter(!is.na(stateProvince)) %>%
  distinct()

# Add taxonomy name
tree_df$name <- TAXtab[match(tree_df$OTU, TAXtab$ASVname), "name"]

# Keep one label per unique name
tree_df$label_name <- ifelse(!duplicated(tree_df$name), tree_df$name, NA)

# Keep only tips with names
tip_positions <- tree_plot$data %>%
  filter(isTip) %>%
  filter(!is.na(label))

# Compute clade center for labeling (optional)
clade_labels <- tip_positions %>%
  group_by(label) %>%
  summarise(
    x = mean(x),
    y = mean(y),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Plot tree with tip points and labels
tree_plot_flipped <- revts(tree_plot)

tree_plot %<+% tree_df +
  geom_tippoint(aes(color = stateProvince),
                alpha = 0.5,
                size = 2.5) +

  geom_tiplab(
    aes(label = label_name),
    align = FALSE,     # <-- removes vertical guide lines
    linetype = NULL,   # <-- extra safety (no lines)
    size = 3,
    offset = 0.01,    # <-- very small = right at tip
    hjust = 0,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +

  #scale_color_manual(values = east_west_colors) +

  ggtitle(g) +

  theme_tree2() +

  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10)
  ) +

  expand_limits(x = max(tree_plot$data$x) + 0.02)
```

ASV by genus trees loop and multipannel
```{r}
genus_list <- unique(tax_table(ps_top10)[, "Genus"])
genus_list <- genus_list[!is.na(genus_list)]

plot_list <- list()

for (g in genus_list) {

  ps_g <- subset_taxa(ps2, Genus == g)

  # 🚨 skip if no taxa
  if (ntaxa(ps_g) == 0) next

  # 🚨 skip if no tree
  if (is.null(phy_tree(ps_g, errorIfNULL = FALSE))) next

  tree <- phy_tree(ps_g)

  # sometimes pruning breaks tree validity
  if (is.null(tree)) next

  tree_plot <- ggtree(tree)
  tree_plot <- revts(tree_plot)

  tree_df <- psmelt(ps_g) %>%
    select(OTU, Region) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Region)) %>%
    distinct()

  tree_df$name <- TAXtab[match(tree_df$OTU, TAXtab$ASVname), "name"]
  tree_df$label_name <- ifelse(!duplicated(tree_df$name), tree_df$name, NA)

  p <- tree_plot %<+% tree_df +
    
    geom_tippoint(aes(color = Region),
                  alpha = 0.6,
                  size = 2) +
    
    geom_tiplab(
      aes(label = label_name),
      align = FALSE,
      linetype = NULL,
      size = 3,
      offset = 0.002,
      hjust = 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    
    scale_color_manual(values = east_west_colors) +
    
    ggtitle(g) +
    
    theme_tree2() +
    
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "none"
    ) +
    
    expand_limits(x = max(tree_plot$data$x) + 0.02)

  plot_list[[g]] <- p
}

wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 3)
```

ASV phylo signal 
```{r}
# =========================================================
# EXTRACT TREE
# =========================================================
tree <- as.phylo(asvtree)
tree$node.label <- NULL

# =========================================================
# BUILD RAW EAST / WEST COUNTS
# =========================================================
trait_df <- tree_df %>%
  group_by(OTU) %>%
  summarise(
    east = sum(Region == "east"),
    west = sum(Region == "west"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    total = east + west,
    
    prop_east = ifelse(total > 0, east / total, NA),
    prop_west = ifelse(total > 0, west / total, NA)
  )

trait_df <- trait_df %>%
  mutate(region_bias = prop_east - prop_west)

#Range:
# -1 → fully West
#  0 → mixed
# +1 → fully East


# =========================================================
# ALIGN TO TREE
# =========================================================
trait_df <- trait_df[trait_df$OTU %in% tree$tip.label, ]
trait_df <- trait_df[!duplicated(trait_df$OTU), ]

# IMPORTANT: matrix format required
trait_mat <- trait_df %>%
  dplyr::select(east, west,region_bias) %>%
  as.matrix()

rownames(trait_mat) <- trait_df$OTU

# reorder to match tree
trait_mat <- trait_mat[tree$tip.label, ]

# remove missing tips safely
keep <- !is.na(rowSums(trait_mat))

trait_mat <- trait_mat[keep, ]
tree2 <- drop.tip(tree, tree$tip.label[!keep])

# =========================================================
# MATCH TRAIT VECTOR TO TREE 
# =========================================================

# choose ONE trait for phylosig (must be numeric vector)
trait_vector <- as.numeric(trait_df$region_bias)

# assign names = ASV labels
names(trait_vector) <- trait_df$OTU

# align with tree tips
trait_vector <- trait_vector[tree$tip.label]
var(trait_vector)

# prune tree to match
tree2 <- drop.tip(tree, setdiff(tree$tip.label, names(trait_vector)))

# --- FIX TREE ---
tree2 <- drop.tip(tree, setdiff(tree$tip.label, names(trait_vector)))
tree2$edge.length <- tree2$edge.length + 1e-6

# =========================================================
# PHYLOGENETIC SIGNAL — BLOMBERG’S K
# =========================================================

K_result <- phylosig(
  tree2,
  trait_vector,
  method = "K",
  test = TRUE,
  nsim = 1000
)

print(K_result)
plot(K_result)

# =========================================================
# PHYLOGENETIC SIGNAL — PAGEL’S LAMBDA
# =========================================================

lambda_result <- phylosig(
  tree2,
  trait_vector,
  method = "lambda",
  test = TRUE
)

print(lambda_result)
plot(lambda_result)

tree2$phy <- multi2di(tree2)

```

dist decay by gen
```{r}
### -----------------------------
### 1. Filter genera (from your top 20)
### -----------------------------
tax <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_top10))
region_map <- setNames(meta$Region, meta$labtracking)

top_genera <- unique(tax$Genus)

# Get state vector aligned to samples
state_vec <- meta$stateProvince
names(state_vec) <- sample_names(ps)

# Function: number of states a taxon appears in
taxa_states <- apply(ps_otu, 1, function(x) {
  present_samples <- names(x)[x > 0]
  length(unique(state_vec[present_samples]))
})

# Apply BOTH filters:
# 1. present in >= 5 samples
# 2. present in >= 2 states
keep_taxa <- (rowSums(ps_otu > 0) >= 5) & (taxa_states >= 2)

# Prune phyloseq object
ps3 <- prune_taxa(keep_taxa, ps)

### -----------------------------
### 2. Loop over genera
### -----------------------------
plot_list <- list()
results_list <- list()

for(g in top_genera){

  # Get all ASVs for this genus
  taxa_g <- taxa_names(ps3)[tax$Genus == g]
  if(length(taxa_g) == 0) next

  ps_g <- prune_taxa(taxa_g, ps3)

  # Skip empty phyloseq objects
  if(ntaxa(ps_g) == 0 || nsamples(ps_g) == 0) next

  otu_g <- as(otu_table(ps_g), "matrix")

  if(!taxa_are_rows(ps_g)){
    otu_g <- t(otu_g)
  }

  # Safety checks
  if(nrow(otu_g) == 0 || ncol(otu_g) == 0) next
  if(all(is.na(otu_g))) next
  if(sum(otu_g, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) next

  ### -----------------------------
  ### Bray-Curtis across samples
  ### -----------------------------
  bc <- vegdist(t(otu_g), method = "bray")
  bc_mat <- as.matrix(bc)

  if(all(is.na(bc_mat))) next
  if(nrow(bc_mat) == 0 || ncol(bc_mat) == 0) next

  bc_df <- melt(bc_mat,
                varnames = c("Sample1","Sample2"),
                value.name = "BC_Distance")

  geo_df <- melt(as.matrix(geo_dist),
                 varnames = c("Sample1","Sample2"),
                 value.name = "geo_Distance")

  df <- merge(bc_df, geo_df, by = c("Sample1","Sample2"))

  # Clean
  df <- df %>%
    filter(Sample1 != Sample2) %>%
    mutate(pair_min = pmin(as.character(Sample1), as.character(Sample2)),
           pair_max = pmax(as.character(Sample1), as.character(Sample2))) %>%
    distinct(pair_min, pair_max, .keep_all = TRUE)

  # Convert to similarity for plotting
  df$BC_Similarity <- 1 - df$BC_Distance

  ### -----------------------------
  ### Add region categories
  ### -----------------------------
  df$region1 <- region_map[df$Sample1]
  df$region2 <- region_map[df$Sample2]

  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      Comparison = case_when(
        region1 == "east" & region2 == "east" ~ "within east",
        region1 == "west" & region2 == "west" ~ "within west",
        region1 != region2 ~ "between regions"))

  df$Genus <- g
  plot_list[[g]] <- df

  ### -----------------------------
  ### Fit models per category
  ### -----------------------------
  slopes <- df %>%
    group_by(Comparison) %>%
    filter(n() > 5) %>%
    summarise(
      slope = coef(lm(BC_Similarity ~ geo_Distance))[2],
      intercept = coef(lm(BC_Similarity ~ geo_Distance))[1],
      r2 = summary(lm(BC_Similarity ~ geo_Distance))$r.squared,
      n_pairs = n(),
      mean_similarity = mean(BC_Similarity, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  slopes$Genus <- g
  results_list[[g]] <- slopes
}

### -----------------------------
### 3. Combine outputs
### -----------------------------
plot_df <- bind_rows(plot_list)
genus_results <- bind_rows(results_list)

### -----------------------------
### 5. Plot
### -----------------------------
line_colors <- c(
  "within east" = "#5ab4ac",
  "within west" = "#d8b365",
  "between regions" = "#D85F64"
)

line_colors2 <- darken(line_colors, 0.3)
base_colors  <- lighten(line_colors, 0.3)

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = geo_Distance, y = BC_Similarity)) +

  geom_point(aes(color = Comparison), size = 1.5, alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = base_colors, guide = "none") +

  ggnewscale::new_scale_color() +

  geom_smooth(aes(color = Comparison), method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 1.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = line_colors2) +

  facet_wrap(~Genus, scales = "free_y") +

  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Distance (km)",
    y = "Bray-Curtis Similarity",
    color = "Comparison"
  )
```

genus pheno
```{r}
### ---------------------------
### 1. Extract phyloseq data
### ---------------------------

# OTU table (taxa as rows)
otu <- otu_table(ps3)
if (!taxa_are_rows(otu)) otu <- t(otu)
otu <- as(otu, "matrix")

# Metadata
meta <- as.data.frame(sample_data(ps3))

# Taxonomy
tax <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps3))

# Region vector
region_vec <- meta$Region
names(region_vec) <- rownames(meta)

### ---------------------------
### 2. Sum abundance by region
### ---------------------------

east_samples <- names(region_vec[region_vec == "east"])
west_samples <- names(region_vec[region_vec == "west"])

east_counts <- rowSums(otu[, east_samples, drop = FALSE])
west_counts <- rowSums(otu[, west_samples, drop = FALSE])

asv_counts <- data.frame(
  ASV = rownames(otu),
  east = east_counts,
  west = west_counts
)

# classify ASVs
asv_counts <- asv_counts %>%
  mutate(
    RegionClass = case_when(
      east > 0 & west > 0 ~ "both",
      east > 0 ~ "east",
      west > 0 ~ "west",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# join taxonomy
tax$ASV <- rownames(tax)
df <- left_join(asv_counts, tax, by = "ASV")


### ---------------------------
### 4. Load functional (GTDB) data
### ---------------------------

con <- file('gtdb_family_summary.jsonl.gz', open = 'r')
data <- stream_in(con)
close(con)

df_func <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(data)), function(i) {
  fam <- data$tax_name[i]
  s <- data$summaries[[i]]

  s$pct_true <- s$percentages$true
  s$pct_false <- s$percentages$false
  s$percentages <- NULL

  s$family <- fam
  s
}) |> bind_rows()

df_func <- df_func |> select(family, everything())

### ---------------------------
### 5. Filter for gene count trait
### ---------------------------

df_gene_count <- df_func %>%
  filter(name == "genome size") %>%
  filter(family %in% df$Family) 

### ---------------------------
### 6. Merge ecology + function
### ---------------------------

plot_df1 <- df %>%
  left_join(
    df_gene_count %>% 
      select(family, majority_label_gene_count = majority_label),
    by = c("Family" = "family")
  )

# numeric gene count
plot_df1$gene_count <- as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.]", "", plot_df1$majority_label_gene_count))


### ---------------------------
### 7. Filter for obligate anaerobic
### ---------------------------
unique(df_func$name)

df_ob_ana <- df_func %>%
  filter(name == "oxygen preference") %>%
  filter(family %in% df$Family) %>%
  mutate(
    verdict_ob_ana = case_when(
      grepl("^true", majority_label, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "true",
      grepl("^false", majority_label, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "false",
      grepl("No robust majority", majority_label, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "no_robust_majority"
    )
  )

### ---------------------------
### 8. Merge ecology + obligate anaerobic
### ---------------------------

plot_df1 <- plot_df1 %>%
  left_join(
    df_ob_ana %>% 
      select(family, majority_label_ob_ana = majority_label, verdict_ob_ana, pct_true_ob_ana = pct_true),
    by = c("Family" = "family")
  )

### ---------------------------
### 9. Filter for obligate aerobic
### ---------------------------

df_ob_aer <- df_func %>%
  filter(name == "obligate aerobic") %>%
  filter(family %in% df$Family) %>%
  mutate(
    verdict_ob_aer = case_when(
      grepl("^true", majority_label, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "true",
      grepl("^false", majority_label, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "false",
      grepl("No robust majority", majority_label, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "no_robust_majority"
    )
  )

### ---------------------------
### 8. Merge ecology + obligate aerobic
### ---------------------------

plot_df1 <- plot_df1 %>%
  left_join(
    df_ob_aer %>% 
      select(family, majority_label_ob_aer = majority_label, verdict_ob_aer, pct_true_ob_aer = pct_true),
    by = c("Family" = "family")
  )

### ---------------------------
### 9. Filter for sporulation
### ---------------------------

df_sporulation <- df_func %>%
  filter(name == "sporulation") %>%
  filter(family %in% df$Family) %>%
  mutate(
    verdict_df_sporulation = case_when(
      grepl("^true", majority_label, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "true",
      grepl("^false", majority_label, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "false",
      grepl("No robust majority", majority_label, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "no_robust_majority"
    )
  )

### ---------------------------
### 8. Merge ecology + sporulation
### ---------------------------

plot_df1 <- plot_df1 %>%
  left_join(
    df_sporulation %>% 
      select(family, majority_label_verdict_df_sporulation = majority_label, verdict_df_sporulation, pct_true_verdict_df_sporulation = pct_true),
    by = c("Family" = "family")
  )
```

```{r}
# =========================
# 1. TREE + TAXONOMY
# =========================
tree <- phy_tree(ps3)

tax_df <- data.frame(
  ASV = taxa_names(ps3),
  Family = as.character(tax_table(ps3)[, "Family"]),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    Family = trimws(Family),
    Family = ifelse(is.na(Family) | Family == "", "Unknown", Family)
  )

# =========================
# 2. DATA CLEANING
# =========================
cap <- function(x, q = 0.98){
  lim <- quantile(x, q, na.rm = TRUE)
  pmin(x, lim)
}

ring_df <- plot_df1 %>%
  mutate(
    ASV = as.character(ASV),
    east = log1p(cap(east)),
    west = log1p(cap(west)),
    gene_count = cap(gene_count),
    obligate_anaerobic = majority_label_ob_ana,
    sporulation = verdict_df_sporulation
  ) %>%
  filter(ASV %in% tree$tip.label) %>%
  mutate(
    RegionClass = case_when(
      tolower(RegionClass) == "east" ~ "East",
      tolower(RegionClass) == "west" ~ "West",
      tolower(RegionClass) == "both" ~ "Both",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# Median and SD by region

  summarise(

bray <- vegdist(otu, method = "bray", binary = TRUE)
bray_sim <- 1 - as.matrix(bray)

# 3. Long format + upper triangle only
shared_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(bray_sim)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(as.integer(Var1) < as.integer(Var2)) %>%   # safest filter
  dplyr::mutate(
    Var1 = as.character(Var1),
    Var2 = as.character(Var2),
    PercentShared = Freq * 100
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-Freq)

# 4. Join metadata
shared_df <- shared_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(meta, by = c("Var1" = "labtracking")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(State1 = stateProvince, Region1 = Region) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(meta, by = c("Var2" = "labtracking")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(State2 = stateProvince, Region2 = Region)

# 5. Define comparison categories
shared_df <- shared_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Comparison = dplyr::case_when(
      Region1 == "east" & Region2 == "east" ~ "within east",
      Region1 == "west" & Region2 == "west" ~ "within west",
      Region1 != Region2 ~ "between regions (east vs west)",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

summary <- shared_df %>%
  group_by(Comparison) %>%
  summarise(mean_percent = mean(PercentShared), .groups = "drop")

print(summary)

sd <- shared_df %>%
  group_by(Comparison) %>%
  summarise(mean_percent = sd(PercentShared), .groups = "drop")

print(sd)

comparisons <- list(
  c("within east", "within west"),
  c("within east", "between regions (east vs west)"),
  c("within west", "between regions (east vs west)")
)

ggplot(shared_df, aes(x = Comparison, y = PercentShared, fill = Comparison)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = Comparison),
              width = 0.15, size = 1, shape = 21, color = "black") +
stat_compare_means(

)+
```

Bayesian Generalized (Non-)Linear Multivariate Multilevel Models
```{r}
#### Create metadata -------------
#geo_dist
#ps_bc_dist
#ps_sor_dist

### =========================
### 1. Melt distance matrices
### =========================

melted_BC <- melt(
  as.matrix(ps_sor_dist),
  varnames = c("Sample1", "Sample2"),
  value.name = "BC_Dissimilarity"
)

melted_geo <- melt(
  as.matrix(geo_dist),
  varnames = c("Sample1", "Sample2"),
  value.name = "geo_Distance"
)

### =========================
### 2. SAFE merge
### =========================
melted_diffs <- left_join(
  melted_geo,
  melted_BC,
  by = c("Sample1", "Sample2")
)

### =========================
### 3. Convert to similarity
### =========================
melted_diffs <- melted_diffs %>%
  mutate(
    BC_Similarity = 1 - BC_Dissimilarity
  )

### =========================
### 4. Remove duplicates + self-comparisons
### =========================
melted_diffs <- melted_diffs %>%
  filter(Sample1 != Sample2) %>%
  mutate(
    pair_min = pmin(as.character(Sample1), as.character(Sample2)),
    pair_max = pmax(as.character(Sample1), as.character(Sample2))
  ) %>%
  distinct(pair_min, pair_max, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(Sample1, Sample2, geo_Distance, BC_Similarity)

### =========================
### 5. Add region metadata
### =========================
region_map <- setNames(meta$Region, meta$labtracking)

melted_diffs <- melted_diffs %>%
  mutate(
    region1 = region_map[Sample1],
    region2 = region_map[Sample2],
    compairson = case_when(
      region1 == "east" & region2 == "east" ~ "within east",
      region1 == "west" & region2 == "west" ~ "within west",
      TRUE ~ "between regions (east vs west)"
    ),
    same_region = region1 == region2
  )

### =========================
### 6. Scale distance
### =========================
range.use <- function(x, min.use, max.use) {
  (x - min(x, na.rm = TRUE)) /
    (max(x, na.rm = TRUE) - min(x, na.rm = TRUE)) *
    (max.use - min.use) + min.use
}

melted_diffs <- melted_diffs %>%
  mutate(
    dist_scaled = range.use(geo_Distance, 0, 1),
    dist_100 = geo_Distance / 100,
    dist_z = as.numeric(scale(dist_100))
  )

### =========================
### 7. Clean factor levels
### =========================
melted_diffs$compairson <- factor(
  melted_diffs$compairson,
  levels = c("within east", "within west", "between regions (east vs west)")
)

### =========================
### 8. Colors 
### =========================
library(colorspace)
library(ggnewscale)

base_colors <- c(
  "within east" = "#5ab4ac",
  "within west" = "#d8b365",
  "between regions (east vs west)" = "#D85F64"
)

line_colors <- darken(base_colors, 0.3)

### =========================
### 9. Plot 
### =========================
p <- ggplot(melted_diffs, aes(x = geo_Distance, y = BC_Similarity)) +

  # points
  geom_point(aes(color = compairson), size = 2, alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = base_colors, guide = "none") +

  ggnewscale::new_scale_color() +

  # group-specific lines
  geom_smooth(
    aes(color = compairson),
    method = "lm",
    se = FALSE,
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = line_colors, name = "Comparison") +

  labs(
    x = "Distance (km)",
    y = "Bray-Curtis Similarity"
  ) +

  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text  = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 11)
  )

print(p)

### =========================
### 10. Prepare for BRMS 
### =========================
# Avoid exact 0/1 for Beta regression
n <- nrow(melted_diffs)
melted_diffs$BC_Similarity <- (melted_diffs$BC_Similarity * (n - 1) + 0.5) / n

### =========================
### 11. Model (FIXED)
### =========================
library(brms)

model <- brm(
  BC_Similarity ~ 1 + dist_scaled * compairson +
    (1 | mm(Sample1, Sample2)),
  data = melted_diffs,
  family = Beta(),
  warmup = 2000,
  iter = 6000,
  chains = 4,
  cores = 4,              # safer default; increase if stable
  threads = threading(4),
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95),
  init = 0
)
summary(model)

#Scale distance within region
#Use || for random slopes
#Add priors + increase adapt_delta

# || removes slope–intercept correlation
#within-region scaling removes confounding
#priors regularize weakly identified slopes
#distance is still biologically meaningful

#You’ll get:
#distance–decay slope for within-region pairs
#distance–decay slope for across-region pairs

#If:
#slopes differ → region-specific decay
#slopes similar but intercepts differ → Mississippi as a barrier
#across-region slope = 0 → distance irrelevant once region differs
```

```{r}
#========================================================
# Combine PERMANOVA results into one table
#========================================================

extract_permanova <- function(model, level, metric) {
  
  out <- as.data.frame(model)
  
  data.frame(
    Level      = level,
    Metric     = metric,
    R2         = out$R2[1],
    F          = out$F[1],
    P_value    = out$`Pr(>F)`[1]
  )
}

permanova_results <- bind_rows(
  
  extract_permanova(permanova_asv_bray,     "ASV",     "Bray-Curtis"),
  extract_permanova(permanova_asv_sor,      "ASV",     "Sorensen"),
  
  extract_permanova(permanova_species_bray, "Species", "Bray-Curtis"),
  extract_permanova(permanova_species_sor,  "Species", "Sorensen"),
  
  extract_permanova(permanova_genus_bray,   "Genus",   "Bray-Curtis"),
  extract_permanova(permanova_genus_sor,    "Genus",   "Sorensen")
  
)

# round values for cleaner display
permanova_results <- permanova_results %>%
  mutate(
    R2      = round(R2, 4),
    F       = round(F, 4),
    P_value = signif(P_value, 3)
  )

print(permanova_results)
```

mantel tests
```{r}
# =========================
# 1. Region map + groups
# =========================
region_map <- setNames(meta$Region, meta$labtracking)

east_samples <- names(region_map[region_map == "east"])
west_samples <- names(region_map[region_map == "west"])

# =========================
# 2. Mantel function
# =========================
run_mantel <- function(dist1, dist2) {
  vegan::mantel(dist1, dist2, permutations = 9999, method = "spearman")
}

# =========================
# 3. EAST
# =========================
mantel_bc_east <- run_mantel(
  as.dist(as.matrix(ps_bc_dist)[east_samples, east_samples]),
  as.dist(as.matrix(geo_dist)[east_samples, east_samples])
)

mantel_sor_east <- run_mantel(
  as.dist(as.matrix(ps_sor_dist)[east_samples, east_samples]),
  as.dist(as.matrix(geo_dist)[east_samples, east_samples])
)

# =========================
# 4. WEST
# =========================
mantel_bc_west <- run_mantel(
  as.dist(as.matrix(ps_bc_dist)[west_samples, west_samples]),
  as.dist(as.matrix(geo_dist)[west_samples, west_samples])
)

mantel_sor_west <- run_mantel(
  as.dist(as.matrix(ps_sor_dist)[west_samples, west_samples]),
  as.dist(as.matrix(geo_dist)[west_samples, west_samples])
)

# =========================
# 5. BETWEEN REGIONS 
# =========================

bc_mat  <- as.matrix(ps_bc_dist)
sor_mat <- as.matrix(ps_sor_dist)
geo_mat <- as.matrix(geo_dist)

samples <- rownames(bc_mat)

pairs <- expand.grid(samples, samples)

region1 <- region_map[pairs$Var1]
region2 <- region_map[pairs$Var2]

keep <- region1 != region2   # EAST vs WEST only

bc_vals <- bc_mat[cbind(pairs$Var1, pairs$Var2)][keep]
sor_vals <- sor_mat[cbind(pairs$Var1, pairs$Var2)][keep]
geo_vals <- geo_mat[cbind(pairs$Var1, pairs$Var2)][keep]

between_bc<-mantel(as.dist(bc_vals), as.dist(geo_vals),method = "spearman", permutations = 999, parallel = getOption("mc.cores"))

between_sor<-mantel(as.dist(sor_vals), as.dist(geo_vals),method = "spearman", permutations = 999, parallel = getOption("mc.cores"))

# =========================
# 6. RESULTS TABLE
# =========================
results <- data.frame(
  group = c("east", "west", "between"),
  
  bc_stat = c(
    mantel_bc_east$statistic,
    mantel_bc_west$statistic,
    between_bc$statistic
  ),
  
  bc_p = c(
    mantel_bc_east$signif,
    mantel_bc_west$signif,
    between_bc$p.value
  ),
  
  sor_stat = c(
    mantel_sor_east$statistic,
    mantel_sor_west$statistic,
    between_sor$statistic
  ),
  
  sor_p = c(
    mantel_sor_east$signif,
    mantel_sor_west$signif,
    between_sor$p.value
  )
)

results
```

physical distance matrix using GPS
```{r}
gps <- as.data.frame(mpse_samples_filtered@colData)[, c("labtracking","stateProvince","decimalLatitude","decimalLongitude","Region")]

locations <- unique(gps$stateProvince)

####################
# Physical distance#
####################
sf_points <- st_as_sf(
  gps,
  coords = c("decimalLongitude", "decimalLatitude"),
  crs = 4326  # WGS84
)

dist_matrix <- st_distance(sf_points)

# Set row/column names
rownames(dist_matrix) <- gps$labtracking
colnames(dist_matrix) <- gps$labtracking

dist_object <- as.dist(dist_matrix)

# Perform hierarchical clustering 
hc_tree <- hclust(dist_object, method = "complete") 
hc_phylo <- as.phylo(hc_tree)

# Create the expanded tree
expanded_tree <- hc_phylo
for(stateProvince in hc_phylo$tip.label) {
  # Find all samples for this stateProvince
  samples <- gps$labtracking[gps$stateProvince == stateProvince]
  
  if(length(samples) > 0) {
    # Find the tip position for this stateProvince
    tip_position <- which(expanded_tree$tip.label == stateProvince)
    
    if(length(samples) == 1) {
      # If only one sample, just rename the tip
      expanded_tree$tip.label[tip_position] <- samples[1]
    } else {
      # If multiple samples, we need to add them as a polytomy
      # First, rename the original tip to the first sample
      expanded_tree$tip.label[tip_position] <- samples[1]
      
      # Then add the rest as sister tips (with very small branch length)
      for(i in 2:length(samples)) {
        expanded_tree <- phytools::bind.tip(expanded_tree, 
                                            tip.label = samples[i],
                                            where = tip_position,
                                            position = 0.0001)  # tiny branch length
      }
    }
  }
}

plot(expanded_tree)

# Match tip labels to rows in gps
tip_index <- match(expanded_tree$tip.label, gps$labtracking)

# Get habitats for all tips (NA if no match)
tip_habitats <- as.character(gps$Region[tip_index])

# Look up colors in habitat_colors
tip_colors <- east_west_colors[tip_habitats]

# Replace any missing colors with black
tip_colors[is.na(tip_colors)] <- "black"

#build tip color vector from your state/colors (must be same length as nrow(assoc))
gps$tip_colors <- east_west_colors[
  match(gps$land_use, names(east_west_colors))
]
names(gps$tip_colors) <- gps$labtracking

phy_tree <- as.phylo(expanded_tree)

# Plot the tree with colored tips
plot(phy_tree, 
     tip.color = tip_colors,
     cex = 0.6,
     no.margin = TRUE)
```

SOR pcoa
```{r}
library(ggside)
# -----------------------------
# Sørensen distance
# -----------------------------

otu <- as(otu_table(ps), "matrix")

if (taxa_are_rows(ps)) {
  otu <- t(otu)
}

# presence/absence
otu.pa <- ifelse(otu > 0, 1, 0)

# Sørensen dissimilarity
sor_dist <- vegdist(otu.pa, method = "bray", binary = TRUE)

# -----------------------------
# PCoA
# -----------------------------

pcoa_res <- cmdscale(sor_dist, eig = TRUE, k = 2)

# Percent variance explained
var_exp <- round(
  100 * pcoa_res$eig / sum(pcoa_res$eig[pcoa_res$eig > 0]),
  2
)

# Dataframe
pcoa_df <- data.frame(
  SampleID = rownames(pcoa_res$points),
  PCo1 = pcoa_res$points[,1],
  PCo2 = pcoa_res$points[,2]
)

# Metadata
meta <- data.frame(sample_data(ps))
meta$SampleID <- rownames(meta)

pcoa_df <- left_join(pcoa_df, meta, by = "SampleID")

# Match ordering
pcoa_df$Region <- factor(
  pcoa_df$Region,
  levels = c("east", "west")
)

# flip horizontally
pcoa_df$PCo1 <- -1 * pcoa_df$PCo1

# -----------------------------
# Plot
# -----------------------------

p <- ggplot(pcoa_df, aes(PCo1, PCo2, color = Region, fill = Region)) +

  geom_hline(yintercept = 0,
             linetype = "dashed",
             color = "grey45",
             linewidth = 0.4) +

  geom_vline(xintercept = 0,
             linetype = "dashed",
             color = "grey45",
             linewidth = 0.4) +

  stat_ellipse(
    geom = "path",
    linewidth = 0.4,
    level = 0.80
  ) +

  geom_point(
    size = 3,
    alpha = 0.95,
    stroke = 0.4,
    show.legend = TRUE,
    shape = 21,  # allows separate fill + outline
    color = "grey45", 
  ) +

  geom_xsideboxplot(
    aes(y = Region),
    orientation = "y",
    width = 0.6,
    outlier.shape = 16,
    outlier.size = 1.8,
    fatten = 1,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.7,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  geom_ysideboxplot(
    aes(x = Region),
    orientation = "x",
    width = 0.6,
    outlier.shape = 16,
    outlier.size = 1.8,
    fatten = 1,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.7,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(values = east_west_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = east_west_colors) +

labs(
  x = paste0("PCo1 (", var_exp[1], "%)"),
  y = paste0("PCo2 (", var_exp[2], "%)")
)+

  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = c(-0.32, 0.28),
    ylim = c(-0.33, 0.33)
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +

  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(
      color = "grey45",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 0.8
    ),

    axis.line = element_blank(),

    legend.position = "right",

    legend.title = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),

    axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 9),

    ggside.panel.scale = 0.25,

    ggside.axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
    ggside.axis.ticks = element_blank(),

    # angle right-side labels
    ggside.axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = -45
    ),

    panel.grid = element_blank(),

    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
  ) +

  # make legend points
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(
        shape = 16,
        size = 4,
        alpha = 1
      )
    )
  )
p
```

codiversity attempt 
```{r}
#---------------------------
# Taxonomic aggregation
#---------------------------
ps_Family <- tax_glom(ps, taxrank = "Genus", NArm = TRUE)

#---------------------------
# Clean taxa & samples
#---------------------------
ps_clean <- ps_Family %>%
  prune_taxa(taxa_sums(.) > 0, .) %>%
  prune_samples(sample_sums(.) > 0, .)

taxa_names(ps_clean) <- make.unique(taxa_names(ps_clean))


#---------------------------
# Prevalence filtering (≥5%)
#---------------------------
asv_mat <- as(otu_table(ps_clean), "matrix")
prev <- rowSums(asv_mat > 0)
keep <- prev >= 0.05 * ncol(asv_mat)
ps_clean <- prune_taxa(keep, ps_clean)

#---------------------------
# Split asvs by Phylum
#---------------------------
tax_df <- as(tax_table(ps_clean), "matrix") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("asv") %>%
  select(asv, Phylum)

asv_by_phylum <- split(tax_df$asv, tax_df$Phylum)

#---------------------------
# Split asvs by Family
#---------------------------
#tax_df <- as(tax_table(ps_clean), "matrix") %>%
#  as.data.frame() %>%
#  rownames_to_column("asv") %>%
#  select(asv, Family)

#asv_by_Family <- split(tax_df$asv, tax_df$Family)

#---------------------------
# Build Left Trees (per phylum)
#---------------------------
scale_left <- 1.5

left_tree_plot_df <- map_dfr(names(asv_by_phylum), function(ph) {
  asvs <- asv_by_phylum[[ph]]
  ps_sub <- prune_taxa(asvs, ps_clean)
  
  if (ntaxa(ps_sub) < 2) return(NULL) # skip empty / singleton trees
  
  p <- ggtree(phy_tree(ps_sub)) + theme_tree2()
  
  p$data %>%
    mutate(
      Phylum = ph,
      x = x * scale_left  # scale left tree
    )
})


# Only keep phyla with trees
valid_phyla <- unique(left_tree_plot_df$Phylum)

left_tree_plot_df <- left_tree_plot_df %>%
  filter(Phylum %in% valid_phyla)

left_tip_df <- left_tree_plot_df %>%
  filter(isTip) %>%
  transmute(
    asv = label,
    x_left = x,
    y_left = y,
    Phylum
  )


#---------------------------
# Build Left Trees (per Family)
#---------------------------
#scale_left <- 1.5

#left_tree_plot_df <- purrr::map_dfr(names(asv_by_Family), function(gen) {
#  asvs <- asv_by_Family[[gen]]
#  ps_sub <- prune_taxa(asvs, ps_clean)

#  if (ntaxa(ps_sub) < 2) return(NULL)

#  p <- ggtree(phy_tree(ps_sub)) + theme_tree2()

#  p$data %>%
#    mutate(
#      Family = gen,
#      x = x * scale_left
#    )
#})

#valid_genera <- unique(left_tree_plot_df$Family)

#left_tree_plot_df <- left_tree_plot_df %>%
#  filter(Family %in% valid_genera)

#left_tip_df <- left_tree_plot_df %>%
#  filter(isTip) %>%
#  transmute(
#    asv = label,
#    x_left = x,
#    y_left = y,
#    Family
#  )


#---------------------------
# Build Right Tree (all samples)
#---------------------------
scale_right <- 1.0 # right tree width

p_right <- ggtree(phy_tree) +
  scale_x_reverse() +
  theme_tree2()

right_df <- p_right$data %>%
  filter(isTip) %>%
  transmute(
    labtracking = label,
    x_right = x,
    y_right = y
  )

right_tree_df <- p_right$data
max_x <- max(right_tree_df$x, na.rm = TRUE)
# flip tips to face left
right_tree_df <- right_tree_df %>%
  mutate(
    x = max(x, na.rm = TRUE) - x # mirror
  )

# normalize and scale
right_tree_df <- right_tree_df %>%
  mutate(
    x = (x - min(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / (max(x, na.rm = TRUE) - min(x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    x = x * scale_right
  )

right_tip_df <- right_tree_df %>%
  filter(isTip) %>%
  transmute(
    labtracking = label,
    x_base = x,
    y_base = y
  )

#---------------------------
# Shift right trees per phylum
#---------------------------
max_left_x_df <- left_tree_plot_df %>%
  group_by(Phylum) %>%
  summarize(max_left_x = max(x, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# replicate right tree for each valid phylum
right_tree_df <- right_tree_df %>%
  crossing(Phylum = valid_phyla) %>%
  left_join(max_left_x_df, by = "Phylum") %>%
  mutate(x = x + max_left_x + 1) # shift right tree after left tree

right_tip_df <- right_tip_df %>%
  crossing(Phylum = valid_phyla) %>%
  left_join(max_left_x_df, by = "Phylum") %>%
  mutate(x_right = x_base + max_left_x + 1,
         y_right = y_base) %>%
  select(labtracking, x_right, y_right, Phylum)

#---------------------------
# Shift right trees per Family
#---------------------------
#max_left_x_df <- left_tree_plot_df %>%
#  group_by(Family) %>%
#  summarize(max_left_x = max(x, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

#right_tree_df <- right_tree_df %>%
#  crossing(Family = valid_genera) %>%
#  left_join(max_left_x_df, by = "Family") %>%
#  mutate(x = x + max_left_x + 1)

#right_tip_df <- right_tip_df %>%
#  crossing(Family = valid_genera) %>%
#  left_join(max_left_x_df, by = "Family") %>%
#  mutate(
#    x_right = x_base + max_left_x + 1,
#    y_right = y_base
#  ) %>%
#  select(labtracking, x_right, y_right, Family)

#---------------------------
# Build links
#---------------------------
asv_mat <- as(otu_table(ps_clean), "matrix")

links <- asv_mat %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("asv") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    -asv,
    names_to = "labtracking",
    values_to = "Abundance"
  ) %>%
  filter(Abundance > 0) %>%
  left_join(tax_df, by = "asv") %>%
  #filter(Phylum %in% valid_genera) %>% # only valid phyla
  left_join(as(sample_data(ps_clean), "data.frame"), by = "labtracking") %>%
  mutate(
    w = scales::rescale(log10(Abundance + 1), c(0.2, 1))
  )

links_plot <- links %>%
  left_join(left_tip_df,  by = c("asv", "Phylum")) %>%
  left_join(right_tip_df, by = c("labtracking", "Phylum")) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(x_left) & !is.na(y_left) &
    !is.na(x_right) & !is.na(y_right)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    x_right = ifelse(x_left == x_right, x_right + 1e-6, x_right),
    y_right = ifelse(y_left == y_right, y_right + 1e-6, y_right)
  )



#---------------------------
# Plot
#---------------------------
ggplot() +
  # LEFT trees
  geom_tree(
    data = left_tree_plot_df,
    aes(x = x, y = y),
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  # RIGHT trees
  geom_tree(
    data = right_tree_df,
    aes(x = x, y = y),
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  # LINKS
  geom_curve(
    data = links_plot,
    aes(
      x = x_left,
      y = y_left,
      xend = x_right,
      yend = y_right,
      color = Region,
      linewidth = w
    ),
    curvature = 0.1,
    alpha = 0.3
  ) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2", name = "Region") +
  scale_linewidth(range = c(0.2, 1), guide = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~Phylum, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_void() +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off")

```

top 20 PCoA with individuals as points
```{r}
# Step 1: Get all Families 
families <- unique(as.vector(tax_table(ps_top20)[, "Genus"]))
families <- families[!is.na(families)]


# Step 2: Prepare containers
pcoa_list   <- list()
axis_labels <- list()

for (fam in families) {

  # Subset by Family
  ps_sub <- subset_taxa(ps, Genus == fam)

  # Remove empty samples
  ps_sub <- prune_samples(sample_sums(ps_sub) > 0, ps_sub)

  # Distance matrix
  dist_mat <- tryCatch(
    phyloseq::distance(ps_sub, method = "bray"),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(dist_mat)) next

  # PCoA
  pcoa_res <- tryCatch(
    ape::pcoa(dist_mat),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(pcoa_res)) next

  # Variance explained (guard against NA)
  var_exp <- round(
    100 * pcoa_res$values$Relative_eig[1:2],
    1
  )
  if (any(is.na(var_exp))) next

  # Sample metadata
  sample_df <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_sub))

  # PCoA dataframe
  pcoa_df <- data.frame(
    Sample = rownames(sample_df),
    PC1    = pcoa_res$vectors[, 1],
    PC2    = pcoa_res$vectors[, 2],
    land_use = sample_df$land_use,
    Region = sample_df$Region,
    Genus = fam
  )

  # Store facet title
  axis_labels[[fam]] <- data.frame(
    Genus = fam,
    title  = paste0(
      fam,
      "\nPC1 (", var_exp[1], "%) | PC2 (", var_exp[2], "%)"
    )
  )

  pcoa_list[[fam]] <- pcoa_df
}

# Combine results
combined_pcoa <- bind_rows(pcoa_list)
axis_labels   <- bind_rows(axis_labels)

combined_pcoa <- combined_pcoa %>%
  left_join(axis_labels, by = "Genus") %>%
  mutate(title = factor(title, levels = unique(title)))

# Step 3: Plot
ggplot(
  combined_pcoa,
  aes(PC1, PC2, color = Region)
) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  stat_ellipse(
    aes(group = Region),
    level = 0.95,
    linetype = 2,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ title, scales = "free") +
  scale_color_manual(values = east_west_colors) +
  theme_bw()

```

with abundance 
```{r}
# Step 1: Get all Families 
families <- unique(as.vector(tax_table(ps_top20)[, "Species"]))
families <- families[!is.na(families)]

# Step 2: Prepare containers
pcoa_list   <- list()
axis_labels <- list()

for (fam in families) {

  # Subset by Species
  ps_sub <- subset_taxa(ps, Species == fam)

  # Remove empty samples
  ps_sub <- prune_samples(sample_sums(ps_sub) > 0, ps_sub)

  # Skip if too few samples
 if (length(sample_names(ps_sub)) < 3) next

  # -------------------------
  # Get abundance per sample
  # -------------------------
  abundance <- sample_sums(ps_sub)

  # Distance matrix
  dist_mat <- tryCatch(
    phyloseq::distance(ps_sub, method = "bray"),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(dist_mat)) next

  # PCoA
  pcoa_res <- tryCatch(
    ape::pcoa(dist_mat),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(pcoa_res)) next

  # Variance explained
  var_exp <- round(
    100 * pcoa_res$values$Relative_eig[1:2],
    1
  )
  if (any(is.na(var_exp))) next

  # Sample metadata
  sample_df <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_sub))

  # PCoA dataframe (ADD abundance)
  pcoa_df <- data.frame(
    Sample    = rownames(sample_df),
    PC1       = pcoa_res$vectors[, 1],
    PC2       = pcoa_res$vectors[, 2],
    Region    = sample_df$Region,
    Abundance = abundance[rownames(sample_df)],
    Family    = fam
  )

  # Store facet title
  axis_labels[[fam]] <- data.frame(
    Family = fam,
    title  = paste0(
      fam,
      "\nPC1 (", var_exp[1], "%) | PC2 (", var_exp[2], "%)"
    )
  )

  pcoa_list[[fam]] <- pcoa_df
}

# Combine results
combined_pcoa <- bind_rows(pcoa_list)
axis_labels   <- bind_rows(axis_labels)

combined_pcoa <- combined_pcoa %>%
  left_join(axis_labels, by = "Family") %>%
  mutate(title = factor(title, levels = unique(title))) 

combined_pcoa <- combined_pcoa %>%
  mutate(Abundance_log = log10(Abundance + 1))

# Step 3: Plot
ggplot(
  combined_pcoa,
  aes(PC1, PC2,
      color = Region,
      shape = Region,
      size  = Abundance)
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.75) +
  stat_ellipse(
    aes(group = Region),
    level = 0.95,
    linetype = 2,
    linewidth = 0.6,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ title, scales = "free") +
  scale_color_manual(values = east_west_colors) +
  
  # Cleaner size scaling
  scale_size_continuous(
    range = c(2, 7),
    breaks = pretty(combined_pcoa$Abundance, n = 4),
    name = "Abundance"
  ) +
  
  guides(
    size = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(alpha = 1)
    )
  ) +
  
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

```
